summary: Every scalar of MovementProfile.Default. The August client ships NO speed table (D32, docs/40 s4.1), so not one number here is the client's; speed scalars derive from the owner's Z1 values; startup ramps are 0.35 seconds and stopping ramps are zero under the 2026-09-08 request.

rows.note: The owner's own stopwatch calibration against a metre Cranberry re-derived from its own client (docs/76 s2.3). Z1's wire stat 2 is the integer 1; 4.10 is the layer above it.
The headline. ZoneSpeed.cs:553's RetailSprintMultiplier = 1.30 is dead code and must not be used; 1.40 x 4.10 = 5.74 m/s.

D59 adopts 0.75 (3.08 m/s) over wave 4's 0.50 even though the owner once called backpedal too fast; the base drop from 5.50 to 4.10 pays for the ratio rise. Two owner rulings genuinely conflict here and D59 flags it rather than resolving it silently.
Triple-anchored and already Cranberry's before the port (docs/76 s2.3); equal to backpedal on purpose, so the posture ladder is walk < crouch < backpedal == strafe < run < sprint.

rows.source: User request 2026-09-06: Shift while prone must roll faster; docs/movement-input-20260906.md
rows.note: Policy: roll equals base jog speed (4.10 m/s): base 4.10 x prone 0.40 x roll 2.50. Native 14158ffb0 sets the roll qualifier for held Sprint; 1411ad740 consumes stat 84 on the lateral axis. Supersedes the unobserved 0.50 default that made a roll slower than ordinary prone strafing.

rows.source: docs/76 s2.7; Cranberry's own value, Z1's 0 explicitly REFUSED
rows.note: Z1 ships SwimSpeedModifier = 0, harmless on an unused 1087 branch; at 1148 swim is a live stance branch and a zero freezes the swimmer. D56 keeps 0.55.
